newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch money market slack, no news to move prices.
newsitem.headline: Dutch money market slack, no news to move prices.

text.p: Dutch money market rates were again unmoved on Wednesday in extremely thin trade.
Call traded at a rate of around 2.90 percent, unchanged with other money market rates.
"There's little motivation for market players to act at the moment. We'll be waiting for the outcome of the FOMC and BUBA meetings," one dealer said.
He said the release of German December manufacturing orders this morning had not had any impact on the Dutch money market.
The orders had fallen 1.4 percent from November, while economists had forecast a 3.3 percent rise.
"Maybe later during the day, there'll be some volume. It all depends on any big things being announced or not," one dealer said.
